photography: Look beyond the main subject. Compare the symmetry, windows and the central axis of the building. One architectural detail will point you towards the code.
crossword: Read only the marked fields. Follow the arrows rather than reading from top to bottom.
tracking: Follow only the signs marked in red. Ignore repeated symbols and keep the order in which you find them.
cards: Arrange the cards in chronological order. Read the marked characters from the oldest event to the newest.
